verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a customer testimonial featured on railway.com praising Railway for 'allowing hard spending limits.' That is affirmative, but there is no first-party documentation of how the limits are configured, whether they are truly hard caps (e.g., stopping services when reached), or at what scope they apply. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the spending-limit feature and its configuration, documented enforcement behavior when the limit is hit, workspace/project scope details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set hard spending limits to control my cloud costs

citations.quote: really gotta commend @Railway for allowing hard spending limits, I have never, ever seen this with any cloud provider.
